8-Day Morocco Desert Tour: Fez to Marrakech
summary:
The 8-Day Morocco Tour crosses the country inland from Fez to Marrakech, with the Sahara forming the defining middle section of the journey. Leaving Fez, the road passes through the Middle Atlas before reaching the Erg Chebbi dunes near Merzouga. From the desert, continue through Todra Gorge and Morocco’s southern valleys to Ouarzazate, a region known for its kasbahs and distinctive earthen architecture, before finishing in Marrakech.
Longer distances are covered privately by road, making the changing landscape part of the experience. The year-round program provides selected hotels, breakfast, English-speaking local guides, transfers, entrance fees and scheduled sightseeing along the route.

itinerary.title: Arrival to Fez
itinerary.text:
Arrival at Fès–Saïss Airport and meet with our representative. Transfer to your hotel in Fez.
Hotel check-in after 14:00. Free time for the rest of the day. Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Fez City Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Guided tour of Fez, the spiritual capital of Morocco. Explore the Medieval Medina and traditional souks. Visit the Bou Inania Madrasa or Attarine Medersa, Nejjarine Fountain, and the Moulay Idriss II Mausoleum. See the exterior of the historic University of al-Qarawiyyin Mosque. Optional traditional lunch in the Medina followed by an afternoon visit to the local souks. Overnight in Fez.

itinerary.title: Midelt to Erfoud (480km)
itinerary.text: Drive through Immouzer Kandar and the cedar forests of the Middle Atlas Mountains. Pass by Ifrane, known for its alpine-style architecture and ski resort atmosphere. Continue through Azrou and stop in Midelt for optional lunch. Drive via Errachidia and the scenic Ziz Valley with its palm groves. Arrive in Erfoud, famous for its annual date festival. Overnight in Erfoud.

itinerary.title: Visiting Erfoud
itinerary.text:
Free day at leisure in Erfoud
Optional 1: Half-day tour of Erfoud and Rissani with lunch
Optional 2: 4x4 excursion to the Erg Chebbi dunes with picnic lunch
Optional 3: 4x4 excursion to Merzouga dunes with dinner and overnight.
Overnight in Erfoud or Merzouga desert camp depending on selected option

itinerary.title: Erfoud and Ouarzazate (320km)
itinerary.text: Drive to Tinghir via Tinjdad. Visit the famous Todra Gorge with its dramatic canyon landscapes. Optional lunch during the tour. Continue to the Dades Valley and the scenic Dades Canyons. Drive along the Road of 1,000 Kasbahs to Ouarzazate. Overnight in Ouarzazate.

itinerary.title: Ouarzazate to Marrakech (220km)
itinerary.text:
Early morning visit to Kasbah of Taourirt and Tifoultoute Kasbah
Continue to Aït Benhaddou, the famous UNESCO-listed fortress village
Optional lunch at a restaurant overlooking the Kasbah
Drive to Marrakech via the Tizi n'Tichka mountain pass in the Atlas Mountains
Enjoy panoramic mountain and valley landscapes along the route

itinerary.title: Visiting Marrakech
itinerary.text: Full-day tour of Marrakech. Visit the Menara Gardens, Saadian Tombs, Bahia Palace, Koutoubia Mosque, and explore the traditional souks and Jemaa el-Fnaa square. Optional dinner and folkloric show at Chez Ali. Overnight in Marrakech.

itinerary.title: Transfer to Marrakech Airport
itinerary.text:
Transfer to Marrakech Menara Airport according to your international flight time
Assistance with departure formalities at the airport

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 8-Day Morocco Tour Itinerary?
faqs.a: The 8-Day Morocco Tour Itinerary covers Fez, Erfoud, Ouarzazate, and Marrakech. This journey takes travelers through Morocco's imperial heritage, Sahara Desert landscapes, historic kasbahs, and vibrant cultural centers, providing an unforgettable introduction to the country's diverse attractions. The tour runs for 7 nights and 8 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 8-Day Morocco Tour Itinerary cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €1,495 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, private land transportation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, and transfers according to the itinerary. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and accommodation category.

faqs.q: Is transportation included throughout the tour?
faqs.a: Yes, private land transportation is included throughout the entire itinerary. Comfortable vehicles are used for transfers and sightseeing, allowing travelers to enjoy Morocco's beautiful landscapes while traveling between destinations.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels and traditional Moroccan riads with daily breakfast. Properties are chosen for their comfort, service quality, and authentic Moroccan atmosphere.

faqs.q: Does the tour include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours. Your guide will provide valuable insights into Morocco's history, culture, architecture, and local traditions throughout the journey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Morocco?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines some of Morocco's most iconic destinations and offers an excellent balance of history, culture, desert experiences, and scenic landscapes.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is easy to moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through medinas, historic sites, local markets, and desert areas. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of Fez, Erfoud, Ouarzazate, and Marrakech?
faqs.a: Fez is famous for its UNESCO-listed medieval medina, traditional tanneries, and artisan workshops. Erfoud is known as a gateway to the Sahara Desert and offers stunning desert scenery. Ouarzazate is renowned for its historic kasbahs, dramatic landscapes, and film studios. Marrakech captivates visitors with its lively souks, beautiful palaces, gardens, and the famous Jemaa el-Fnaa Square.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 8-Day Morocco Tour Itinerary?
faqs.a: You can generally cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within the applicable cancellation period may be subject to fees according to the booking terms and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 8-Day Morocco Tour Itinerary be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade accommodations, include luxury desert camp experiences, visit Chefchaouen or Casablanca, or modify the itinerary to suit your travel interests. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
